name: The reporter (Kid vs Dad 01)
source: Kid vs Dad 01 "BREAKING: Dad has told 4,000 dad jokes" (storyboards/series/kid-vs-dad/01-dad-jokes-news/DESIGN.md sections 1 and 2, 22 Nov 2026)
personality: The war correspondent: a stocky reporter in a mid-blue helmet and a navy padded vest, who treats a family garden like a war zone. Deadpan, grim, never smiling; holds a big red-cube news microphone (the prop `newsmic`) in his right hand all film. Faces: reporting = his neutral; duck = eye 0.06, tilt 0.3, browY -0.03, curve -0.3; haunted look = eye 1.15, pupil 0.7, tilt 0.1, curve -0.1, open 0 into the lens.
voiceNote: voice block copied from the agent; tts reaper (the director may tune it)
